head: Microsoft 365 outage on 12 November hit Outlook, Teams and OneDrive
dek: Outlook, Teams, OneDrive, Copilot and other Microsoft 365 services went down for many users on 12 November. Microsoft confirmed the problem could affect connectivity for users in any region.
details: Downdetector showed tens of thousands of reports for each service. Microsoft tracked it under incident EX1550543 in the Microsoft 365 admin center. Some users could keep working through it.
means: If email or Teams stopped working on Thursday, it was Microsoft's side, not your computer.
todo: Check status.cloud.microsoft when Microsoft apps stop working, and resend any email that failed during the outage.
